title: ModerationDecision
description: Agent service to web service: the Moderation result (spec 03). Model errors, timeouts or invalid output always become hold with ruleCodes ["model_error"]; a valid model result with no rule hit but too little confidence to publish becomes hold with ruleCodes ["low_confidence"].

ruleCodes.description: Every rule that fired; empty only when decision is publish.

flaggedSpans.description: Exact spans of the submitted text that triggered a rule, shown to the author on authorFix and to the admin on hold.

authorMessage.description: Short author-facing message in the author's language.

ownHealthDataWarning.description: The author shared their own health details: a gentle warning only, never a hold (R8 note).

proofOfVisit.description: Plausible match with the Provider name and a date within 24 months of the visit month. A rejection never holds the Testimony; it only withholds Kunjungan terbukti. Absent when the check did not run (model error, timeout or invalid output): treat it as not verified, and delete the file anyway.
